name: aws-practitioner-study-lab
description: AWS Practitioner Study Lab — frontend (Next) + backend (Nest) separados

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aps/shared && npm run build -w @aps/backend && npm run build -w @aps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @aps/frontend && npm run lint -w @aps/backend
scripts.local: npm run build -w @aps/shared && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c teal,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
